environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running directly, fronted by an AWS Classic Load Balancer (CLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. The PostgreSQL RDS instance has the application's database user granted SELECT on all columns including api_key. No additional middleware or proxy between CLB and application. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to CLB, and CLB to EC2 on port 8080. RDS security group allows inbound 5432 from EC2 security group. Database user 'app' has role: SELECT on users table with all columns accessible. No query-level firewall or audit on RDS.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic Load Balancer, TCP passthrough
config.db_user_grants: GRANT SELECT ON users TO app
